tagline: EMZANTSI AFRIKA · IMPILO YAKHO, NGESANTYA SAKHO
tracker_intro: Rekhoda uxinzelelo lwegazi neswekile ukuze uzigcinele irekhodi. Le app ayitoliki iziphumo kwaye ayithathi indawo yeengcebiso zonyango.
error_glucose_number: Iswekile yegazi kufuneka ibe linani elisebenzayo.
error_glucose_positive: Iswekile yegazi kufuneka ibe linani elingaphezulu kuno-zero nelinokulinganiswa.
error_both_pressure: Faka omabini amaxabiso oxinzelelo lwegazi, oluphezulu nolusezantsi.
error_required_reading: Faka uxinzelelo lwegazi okanye iswekile ngaphambi kokugcina.
cookbook_intro: Iingcamango zokutya okulula. Lungisa izithako ngokweemfuno zakho.
no_recipes: Akukho ndlela yokupheka ihambelana nophendlo lwakho.
no_herbs: Akukho mayeza esintu ahambelana nophendlo lwakho.
general_herbal_warning:
ISAZISO ESIBALULEKILEYO NGOKHUSELEKO

Amayeza esintu nezongezelelo zinokusebenzisana namayeza kagqirha.

Musa ukuyeka, ukunciphisa okanye ukutshintsha amayeza owamiselwe ngenxa yolwazi olukule app.

Ukuba usebenzisa amayeza afana ne-metformin, i-insulin, i-warfarin, amayeza oxinzelelo lwegazi okanye amanye amayeza exesha elide, thetha nogqirha okanye usokhemesti ngaphambi kokusebenzisa rhoqo amayeza esintu okanye izongezelelo.

Funa uncedo lwezonyango olungxamisekileyo xa uneempawu ezinzima.
